meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会多出两个工具：一个列出 Atomic Chat 本地当前可用的模型，一个把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。Claude 仍是主控，可以把部分任务交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当你说“用 Atomic Chat……”之类的话，或要求本地模型回答问题，或点名使用 atomic_chat 的生成工具时，Claude 就会调用这些工具。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: 触发模型列表查询并生成回答

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 当前可用的模型

howto.what_en: Adds two tools to Claude: one lists models currently available in the local Atomic Chat app, the other sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns the answer. Claude stays the orchestrator and can hand subtasks to local models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to use Atomic Chat, request a local model to answer, or explicitly name the atomic_chat_generate tool.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France.
List the models currently available in atomic chat.
Ask llama3.2 via atomic_chat_generate to explain quantum computing.
say_en.note: Directly targets a model for generation.
